publication_status: Published profile — taxonomy notes independently maintained
taxonomy_summary: Crossotarsus niponicus Blandford, 1894. Original description and historical taxonomic treatments are displayed with claim-specific source verification; provisional distribution and host assertions remain separate from nomenclatural decisions.
nomenclature_note: Blandford's 1894 pp. 130–131 original Crossotarsus niponicus description is directly verified, and its Japanese original provenance is separate from Taiwan occurrence reports.

resources.images: No image with confirmed public reuse rights is linked in this release.
resources.specimens: Specimen/type evidence is recorded in the cited original descriptions; specimen accessions have not been independently mapped to online repositories.

provenance.scope: Distribution and host evidence consolidated for website display; separate nomenclatural uncertainties remain recorded.
